name: echarts-terminal
description: Terminal renderer plugin for Apache ECharts

scripts.coverage:src: node ./node_modules/c8/bin/c8.js --exclude build.mjs --all --src src --reporter=text npm run smoke
scripts.smoke:contract: npm run build && node --loader ./test/node/ts-loader.mjs test/node/src-unit-contract.mjs && node test/node/terminal-plugin-contract.mjs && node test/node/terminal-data-label-contract.mjs && node test/node/terminal-effect-scatter-contract.mjs && node test/node/terminal-interaction-contract.mjs && node test/node/terminal-compare-contract.mjs && node test/node/terminal-visual-export-contract.mjs && node test/node/terminal-app-capture-contract.mjs && node test/node/iterm2-capture-contract.mjs && node test/node/ghostty-capture-contract.mjs && node test/node/ghostty-live-record-contract.mjs && node test/node/real-terminal-compare-contract.mjs && node test/node/terminal-showcase-contract.mjs
scripts.smoke:bun: npm run smoke:contract && sh -c '"${BUN_BIN:-bun}" run test/node/terminal-plugin-smoke.mjs'
scripts.smoke:deno: npm run build && sh -c '"${DENO_BIN:-deno}" run -A --node-modules-dir=auto --import-map test/deno/import_map.json test/deno/terminal-plugin-smoke.mjs'
scripts.visual:update: npm run build && node test/visual/terminal-compare-visual.mjs update
scripts.visual:update:tty: npm run build && node test/visual/terminal-app-capture.mjs update
scripts.visual:update:iterm2: npm run build && node test/visual/iterm2-capture.mjs update
scripts.visual:update:ghostty: npm run build && node test/visual/ghostty-capture.mjs update
scripts.visual:test: npm run build && node test/visual/terminal-compare-visual.mjs test
